proves: Bounded matches in configured installed source, docs, samples or readable resource metadata
doesNotProve: Resource resolution, native compilation, API legality in another module, copying rights
routes.nextStep: Inspect installed API declarations and an existing working addon; adapt the smallest supported extension point. Do not guess GUIDs or extract proprietary packages.

proves: Job schema, dependency/class/file presence, input pins and required assertions
doesNotProve: New native addon creation, engine parsing, inheritance, compiled scripts or gameplay
routes.nextStep: Use an existing binding; otherwise create an addon-owned job with explicit project/world/adapter and a route context. Keep accepted source immutable.

proves: Validated local loopback server configuration bytes; explicit private job/binding edits
doesNotProve: Server startup, native resource-container import or engine-effective inherited configuration
routes.nextStep: Write and inspect explicit configuration files instead of dialog entry; use native readback for effective settings.

proves: Pinned source/export contract and recipe assertions for deterministic export, ownership and native parity
doesNotProve: FBX export execution, native XOB/EDDS import or material binding
routes.nextStep: Reuse the addon-owned exporter and official version-matched metadata; prepare file plans and parity witnesses before any editor operation.

commands: npm run cli -- search-text ResourceManager --rootType doc --limit 20
proves: Only a lead until an addon-owned version-matched importer/plugin is inspected and qualified
doesNotProve: A universal headless import command exists in this harness
routes.nextStep: Inspect the installed Workbench resource/import APIs and existing addon import scripts. Register a supported addon-owned batch action if feasible; pin implementation/readbacks. Mark unsupported only with scoped evidence.

proves: Current native compiler outcome and retained diagnostics after explicit execution
doesNotProve: Serialized world load, gameplay or physical input usability
routes.nextStep: Inspect the dry-run plan, then execute under the existing native owner with fresh logs; diagnose the first addon error.

proves: Fresh nonempty PAK and packaging-success log, with validation first
doesNotProve: Loaded package, ordinary gameplay, publication or license acceptance
routes.nextStep: Use a separate immutable build directory; pin addon.gproj/data.pak/resourceDatabase.rdb from the same build.

proves: GAME admission plus an adapter-measured exact world identity/load
doesNotProve: AI orders, movement, input delivery or human usability; GAME alone is insufficient
routes.nextStep: Prefer the qualified direct-world adapter to F5/menus. The addon owns admission, exact package/world readback, cooperative close and lease.

proves: Actual native simulation deltas after supported registered actions: signed powered progress, traverse, ammunition use or completed crew transitions
doesNotProve: Physical W/S/Tab/F delivery, discoverable controls, human acceptance, or another candidate's capabilities
routes.nextStep: Inspect the current addon adapter and healthy-control receipts. Reuse persistent action/telemetry recipes; pin their exact source and scoped evidence in assessments. Do not infer an action adapter from a capability name.

proves: Measured native effects after supported public component commands with normal guards: completed seat entry, engine start, finite weapon operation
doesNotProve: Registered player-action delivery, physical controls, cinematic aiming or normal reload timing via instant reload
routes.nextStep: Use exact installed component APIs and normal admission guards. Pin the addon-owned adapter; require actual effects and conserved inventory, not a wanted flag or accepted request.

proves: Measured simulation response to supported bounded simulation controls with exact driver/track-map admission
doesNotProve: Registered input-action routing or physical controls; transform/velocity setters cannot qualify propulsion
routes.nextStep: Prefer the qualified registered-action course where applicable. If using direct simulation commands, label that method explicitly and preserve actual signed progress, power/contact overlap and stop/reverse gates.

proves: Explicit reset, seat assignment, position or pose readback for fixture setup only
doesNotProve: Powered movement, public get-in interaction, firing, input usability or gameplay
routes.nextStep: Reuse a qualified addon-owned reset/state adapter; observe independent actual behavior through native-actions for functional assertions.

proves: Fresh decoded native image paired with actual camera/state telemetry and source identity
doesNotProve: Correct model quality, physical input or ordinary crew-camera usability without its separate gates
routes.nextStep: Batch file-based view requests through the current owner's native camera fixture; inspect pixels, loading frames and occupancy. Do not use mouse camera positioning for repeatable views.

commands: Owner-only residual editor operation; no automated input command supplied
proves: Only the observed import/configuration operation with native readback
doesNotProve: Import parity, gameplay or physical-key usability
routes.nextStep: Only after scoped evidence rules out supported resource API/batch routes: record the residual operation, clear owner and necessity, then return to scripts for verification.

commands: Owner-only one bounded observed input probe with a stock control; no custom injection code
proves: Observed supported automation delivery and separately measured behavior within the tested input route
doesNotProve: Physical keyboard usability, causal focus diagnosis or an ASU-specific defect when stock fails
routes.nextStep: Prefer native-actions for behavior; use a delivery probe only for the residual delivery question, with exact readiness/stock evidence. Stop on zero events.

commands: Human owner performs the short exact-candidate ordinary-player acceptance course
proves: Explicit human receipt for discovery, entry/exit, controls, driving, weapons and restored use on the exact candidate
doesNotProve: Untested multiplayer, performance or other candidate versions
routes.nextStep: Retain a small separate human gate after programmatic regressions. The coordinator never substitutes registered actions for physical input.
